title: AI Game Jam
author: DivineMage1
selftext:
Hi folks!

I'm doing this game jam (monster mash theme) - I've got a few entries but these are my best two atm(still a couple weeks left!) - (idle) [https://w.run/bitwisegaming/idle-monster](https://w.run/bitwisegaming/idle-monster) and (roguelite) [https://run.world/bitwisegaming/fleshcrafter](https://run.world/bitwisegaming/fleshcrafter)  
  
If you'd be open to taking a look and giving me feedback that would be awesome! Voting is open so if you wanted you could do that too ;)  
  
Still a couple weeks left if you want to sign-up and do it too (https://run.world/jams/octoberjam) - they are giving away a bunch of AI credits to folks if you build on their platform - you can build locally and use the CLI as well to do the AI generation.
